name: tools.activate
description: Expand full schemas for one or more tool families (tasks, issues, reports, mind, eidoverse, recipes, voice) for the rest of this turn, plus a short retention window afterward. Supply up to five exact toolNames from those granted families to prioritize the next actions when family schemas are budget-limited; repeating family activation alone does not resolve that limit. This only changes which schemas you are shown here — it never grants a capability this mind does not already hold.
